about: Words a reader sees in each place at rest (the main region, on the fake engine; Money with the overview the real engine sends), measured by w3 package 3I on 26 October 2026 and again by w4 package 4Z on 27 October 2026, rounded up to the next 10. A baseline may only shrink: tests/budgets.test.tsx fails when a place grows past its number, or drops a whole step of 10 under it (then lower it), each place may not pass its first measure in "first" (rounded the same way), and the total may not pass firstTotal. Wave 5 measured all 27 places on 29 October 2026. Connections and Connections/AI measure 1804 words each (budgets 870 to 1810); onboarding measures 1148 (330 to 1150, first measure 340 to 1150). Every rise is listed for the founder in the wave 5 PR; all other measured budgets are unchanged.
